On Sat, 05 Jun 2027 at 09:12, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team / Nina —
>

We need to close the MSA redline, get an executed order form, and complete vendor portal setup in order to reach our mid-June SLA for pilot kickoff.

Legal assessment (high level):
- We have 7 redlines flagged; 3 are commercial (pricing/payment waterfall, termination liability cap, and service credits), 4 are data/security (data scope, deletion requirements, subprocessor list, and audit rights).
- Risk prioritization: the termination liability cap and data deletion clause are negotiable; audit-rights and subprocessor transparency are points Orion will likely push back on.

Proposed approach:
1) Deliver a tracked-change MSA with two tiers: (A) minimal/legal-critical edits we cannot concede without exec approval, and (B) commercial items we can flex on with clear alternatives. I'll label each edit with "critical" or "flex" in the attached redline and include a one-line rationale.
2) For IP and liability: propose language that narrows the scope of indemnity to direct damages and adds a mutual cap tied to the first 12 months of charges. If Ori on pushes back, request commercial levers (shorter term, pilot discount).
3) For audit/subprocessors: offer a monthly subprocessor roster update and a scoped SOC 2 report exchange rather than open audit right.

Timeline: I will circulate the annotated MSA (OrionHealth_MSA_redline_20270605.docx) by Monday 06/07 lunchtime PT. If we get countercomments by Wed 06/09 we can target an agreement by 06/14.

Action items for Legal: Lauren -> Annotate redline (critical/flex) by Mon 6/7.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
